shared_elements: anthropomorphic or human-like body/head forms (at most, very general)
justification: The only possible overlap is a very broad interest in human-like or bodily forms: A depicts a single anthropomorphic figure with head, neck, torso and facial features, while B may include highly schematic body-like signs among many animal and abstract motifs. The biggest difference is that A is essentially one naturalized human-like figure, whereas B is a register-like composition of multiple schematic animals, symbols and repeated signs with no comparable single figure or scene.
